name: Damageable
description: Base class for all Damageable entities. It provides Health and Damage related methods and events.

functions.name: ApplyDamage
functions.description_long: Do damage to this entity, will trigger all related events and apply modified damage based on bone. Also will apply impulse if it's a heavy explosion

parameters.name: bone_name
parameters.description: Name of the bone or socket

parameters.name: damage_type
parameters.description: Type of the damage, used for effects and in the damage events

parameters.name: instigator
parameters.description: The player which caused the damage

parameters.name: causer
parameters.description: The object which caused the damage

functions.name: IsDead
functions.description: Returns if the entity is dead

functions.name: Respawn
functions.description: Respawns the Entity, filling its Health and moving it to its Initial Location

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: If not passed will use the initial location passed when the Entity spawned

functions.name: SetHealth
functions.description: Sets the Health of this Entity
functions.description_long: Sets the Health of this Entity. You can only call it on alive Entities (call Respawn first)

parameters.name: new_health
parameters.description: The new Health of this Entity

functions.name: SetMaxHealth
functions.description: Sets the MaxHealth of this Entity

parameters.name: max_health
parameters.description: The new MaxHealth of this Entity

functions.name: SetDamageMultiplier
functions.description: Changes how much damage this entity takes on specific bones

parameters.name: bone_name
parameters.description: Name of the bone or socket

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.description: Damage multiplier for that bone, 1 is the default

functions.name: GetDamageMultiplier
functions.description: Gets the Damage Multiplier of a bone

return.description: the damage multiplier of the bone
return.name: multiplier

parameters.name: bone_name
parameters.description: Name of the bone or socket

events.name: HealthChange
events.description: When Entity has its Health changed, or because took damage or manually set through scripting or respawning

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Damageable that triggered the event

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Damageable that triggered the event

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Damageable that triggered the event

arguments.name: last_damage_taken
arguments.description: Damage of the hit that killed it

arguments.name: last_bone_damaged
arguments.description: Bone hit by the last damage

arguments.name: damage_type_reason
arguments.description: Type of the damage that killed it

arguments.name: hit_from_direction
arguments.description: Direction the last damage came from

arguments.name: instigator
arguments.description: The Player responsible for the death, if any

arguments.name: causer
arguments.description: The object which caused the damage

events.name: TakeDamage
events.description: Triggered when this Entity takes damage

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Damageable that triggered the event

arguments.name: from_direction
arguments.description: Direction of the damage relative to the damaged actor

arguments.name: instigator
arguments.description: The player which caused the damage

arguments.name: causer
arguments.description: The object which caused the damage

return.description: Return the multiplier to the final damage. Return 0 to cancel the damage (will still display animations, particles and apply impact forces). The default 1.0.
